recognize_zh: 未染色濕式鏡檢（sickling test）中，除了圓形紅血球外，可見大量呈新月形、鐮刀狀或冬青葉狀（holly leaf）的變形紅血球，表示存在 HbS。
features: Unstained wet preparation with red cells viewed by bright-field microscopy
Numerous crescent, sickle and holly-leaf shaped red cells
Admixed round biconcave red cells that have not sickled
Some cells appear small, in keeping with microcytosis
No nucleated cells assessable in this preparation
describe_en: Unstained wet-mount sickling test (reducing agent preparation) shows numerous red cells that have deformed into crescent, sickle and holly-leaf shapes, admixed with round cells that have not sickled. The positive sickling test indicates the presence of hemoglobin S but cannot distinguish sickle cell trait from sickle cell disease. Quantitation by hemoglobin electrophoresis or HPLC, which here showed HbS of 26.3% with microcytic indices, is required; the findings are consistent with sickle cell trait with coexisting alpha thalassemia.

ddx.vs: The sickling test is positive in both, so HPLC is required: HbSS lacks HbA with HbS above 80%, whereas trait has HbA predominance.
HbSC is also sickle-test positive but shows HbC on electrophoresis and target cells with crystals on stained smear.
Crenated cells show evenly spaced short spicules around a round outline rather than elongated crescent or holly-leaf forms.
Beta thalassemia trait is sickling-test negative and shows elevated HbA2 above 3.5% without HbS.
